name: Ramp
description: Ramp sells corporate cards, expense management and bill-payment software to businesses, with over 25,000 customers as of 2024 and a $44 billion valuation from a June 2026 round.

name: Tempus
description: Tempus AI applies AI to clinical and molecular data, selling genomic diagnostic tests to physicians and data licensing to pharmaceutical companies; it has traded on Nasdaq since 2024.

name: Replit
description: Replit runs a browser-based AI coding platform whose agent builds and deploys apps for individuals and businesses, reporting over 50 million users and a $9 billion valuation in 2026.

name: Saudi Real Estate
description: PIF-owned Saudi Real Estate Refinance Company buys home mortgage portfolios from Saudi banks and lenders to add housing-finance liquidity, including a SR5 billion deal with Al Rajhi Bank.

name: Exus
description: Exus is a Madrid-based investor and asset manager for wind, solar and small hydro plants, managing over 11 GW for third-party owners in Europe and North America.
note: Partners Group investment (2023), up to EUR 1bn growth capital committed

name: Medtronic
description: Medtronic makes medical devices and therapies for cardiovascular, surgical and neurological conditions, selling to hospitals and clinicians in about 150 countries with roughly 95,000 employees.

name: Prepared
description: Prepared makes AI-assisted 911 call-handling software that combines call audio, text, video, location and live translation for emergency dispatch centers, serving over 1,000 agencies in 49 US states.
note: Acquired by Axon Enterprise (closed Q4 2025); part of Axon 911

name: Cerus
note: could not identify; Cerus Corporation (blood safety, Nasdaq CERS) is based in Concord, CA, not Chicago

name: Seven & I Holding
description: Seven & i Holdings is the Tokyo-listed parent of 7-Eleven, running convenience stores for everyday shoppers, with about 21,600 outlets in Japan and 13,000 in North America.

name: National Debt Management
description: Saudi Arabia's National Debt Management Center, set up in 2015 under the Ministry of Finance, borrows for the state by selling bonds and sukuk to domestic and international investors.
note: Government agency, not a commercial company

name: Joulent
description: Joulent develops multi-gigawatt power generation and high-voltage electrical infrastructure sited next to large energy users such as AI data centers, selling contracted power to those customers.
